events.title: Launched Portfolio
events.description: Rebuilt and shipped my personal portfolio from scratch — a place to document the work, the thinking, and the journey.

events.title: Started Independent Practice
events.description: Left full-time employment to work independently on design projects across branding, product, and editorial.

events.title: Design System Shipped
events.description: Delivered a full design system for a Series A startup — component library, documentation, and contribution guidelines.

events.title: Joined Studio as Lead Designer
events.description: Took on a lead design role at a Jakarta-based creative studio, overseeing projects across digital and print.

events.title: First Solo Exhibition
events.description: Showed a series of illustration and print work at a small gallery in Jakarta — the first time I exhibited outside of school.

events.title: Moved Back to Jakarta
events.description: Returned home after studying abroad. Started re-rooting in the local design and creative community.

events.title: Graduated in Design
events.description: Completed my undergraduate degree in visual communication design. Graduated during a pandemic — ceremonies online, feelings very real.

events.title: Went Fully Remote
events.description: The world paused. I started learning front-end development, took on freelance work, and figured out how to make things from a bedroom.

events.title: UX Mobile Masters SEA
events.description: Bhinneka's mobile design ranked 4th with an overall score of 87% in the ASEAN Mobile Sites Leaderboard for Retail & Commerce — report conducted by Google & Accenture Interactive.

events.title: First Design Internship
events.description: Interned at a branding agency called (cocinero) a design kitchen in Jakarta. Learned that real design work is 90% feedback and 10% the thing you were excited about.

events.title: Discovered Design as a Practice
events.description: Started reading about design intentionally — Dieter Rams, Frank Chimero, design history. Realised making things was something I could do seriously.

events.title: Started Drawing Seriously
events.description: Filled my first sketchbook. Drew every day before school. Didn't know it was the beginning of anything — it just felt necessary.

events.title: Born in Surabaya
events.description: From a chinese-indonesian couple, who fell in love as penpals through a matchmaking ad from a local newspaper.
